name: Apple M2 Max (MacBook Pro / Mac Studio, 2023)
memory_bandwidth_basis: Apple tech specs: M2 Max unified-memory bandwidth is 400 GB/s for the 38-core GPU configuration (300 GB/s on the lower 30-core bin). Package-level, shared with CPU. Research file (research-big-memory.md) cites ~400 GB/s.
notes: Added in the Phase-A gap-fill for the Oct-14 research ingest: research-big-memory.md cites a measured 8.8 tok/s Llama-3.3-70B 4-bit on the M2 Max 38-core 64GB, but the repo had no apple-m2-max record for the benchmark to join to. vram_gb 96 is the max configurable unified pool (64GB and 96GB SKUs; the measured row is the 64GB MacBook Pro which fits a 70B Q4 only at low context). Bandwidth 400 GB/s is roughly half an M1/M2 Ultra's 800 GB/s, which is exactly why the measured 70B decode (~8.8 t/s) lands near half the M1 Ultra's 12.6 t/s - decode scales almost perfectly with memory bandwidth on this class.
